info.title: CivicPulse 402 Municipal Compliance Gateway
info.description: Real-time City of Minneapolis housing code violations, building permits, and Ramsey County parcel GIS audits monetized via Base Mainnet USDC ($0.01 / 10000 atomic units) x402 EIP-3009 micropayments.
info.x-guidance: Query Minneapolis housing violations and building permits by passing { "address": "1700 Penn Ave N", "jurisdiction": "minneapolis" }, or audit Ramsey County parcels by passing { "parcel_id": "04-29-23-41-0012", "jurisdiction": "ramsey" }. Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 402 with Base USDC (eip155:8453) payment terms ($0.01 / 10000 units to 0x0d25A44f74868eCE53B305C97139CF4B62963410) in both PAYMENT-REQUIRED and WWW-Authenticate headers.
